name: bisque-cloud
description: Bisque's plugins: turn what you have into a presentation people can watch.

plugins.name: presenter
plugins.description: Bisque's open-source skills for building narrated presentations you publish to a shareable watch URL. Includes the present skill, which authors and publishes; the watch skill, which reads a published presentation so an agent can summarize or answer questions about it; and the video skill, which renders a published presentation to an MP4 on a Mac. Narration is generated on your own machine.

plugins.name: bisque
plugins.description: Turn a document, a thread, or a set of numbers into a presentation people can watch — slides with a spoken script, at a link you can send. Claude writes it, Bisque records and hosts it, and you get a watch URL that opens in any browser.
